## Meaning

This monitor fired because this member diverged from its peer group. Every peer receives comparable work, so divergence is itself the defect.

Query:

```
avg(last_1h):outliers(avg:acme.streaming.partition_lag{__SCOPE__} by {stream,partition}, 'DBSCAN', 3) > 0
```

**Design note.** Peer comparison is the only honest way to detect skew: every partition is supposed to look like its siblings, so the outlier IS the defect.

## Impact

Nothing is broken yet. A boundary will be crossed if nobody acts within the lead time this monitor provides.

Error budget: this condition is associated with `slo-messaging-delivery`. If the alert is sustained, expect burn-rate alerts on that objective to follow.

## Automation

Workflow `diag-messaging` (diagnostic only) runs automatically on every alert.

Actions: `fetch_monitor`, `consumer_group_state`, `dlq_sample`, `broker_metrics`.

Attached to the alert automatically: consumer group members, 5 sample DLQ messages, broker throughput.

## Escalation

1. Owning team: `cloud-engineering` (see `platform/policy/teams.yaml` for the channel and ServiceNow assignment group).
2. Escalates to: `sre`.
3. Priority contract: P3 — next business day; this never pages.
